title: Total Cardio Master
description: Intense 10-minute EMOM followed by an 8-minute AMRAP for a complete cardio-endurance workout

exercises.name: Joint rotations
exercises.instructions: Neck, shoulders, wrists, hips, ankles - slow and controlled

exercises.name: Jumping jacks
exercises.instructions: Jump spreading arms and legs, return feet together

exercises.name: Inchworms
exercises.instructions: Standing, walk hands forward into a plank, then walk back

exercises.name: Hip 90/90
exercises.instructions: Seated, legs at 90 degrees, pivot from side to side

exercises.name: No-push-up burpees
exercises.instructions: Drop down, jump feet back, return, jump up

exercises.name: Jump squats
exercises.instructions: Explosive squat with a jump, absorb on landing

exercises.name: Alternating lunges
exercises.instructions: Alternate left foot forward then right foot forward without pausing

exercises.name: Push-ups
exercises.instructions: Hands shoulder-width, body straight, chest to the floor

exercises.name: Bicycle crunches
exercises.instructions: Elbow to opposite knee alternating, leg extended

exercises.name: Hamstring stretch
exercises.instructions: Leg extended forward, lean torso forward

exercises.name: Psoas stretch
exercises.instructions: Low lunge, drive the hip forward

exercises.name: Scorpion stretch
exercises.instructions: On your stomach, bring your foot toward the opposite hand while rotating

exercises.name: Deep breathing
exercises.instructions: Inhale 4s through the nose, hold 4s, exhale 6s through the mouth
